scoreMeaning: Schema-required unscored sentinel, not an audio-quality score.
verdictMeaning: The exact recorded evaluator remains rejected after false captions on known controls. This report accepts only a narrow independently verified preprocessing difference, not evaluator repair or product approval.
blindComparison: No blind sound comparison, reference-media evaluation or listening-quality judgment was performed. These numerical checks identify controls and preprocessing behavior only; they cannot determine which sound a stranger would prefer.

findings.shot: Exact zeroPCM negative control in b10809 Qwen2.5Omni audio preprocessing
findings.problem: The pinned b10809 Whisper preprocessing source produces -0.8061800003 in all 384000 returned mel values for the original 64000-sample zero-PCM control. The pinned Transformers v4.52.3 Whisper reference produces -1.5 in all values. Independently rerunning the isolated source with a single 1e-10 floor assignment reproduces exact reference agreement.
findings.why: This is a verified difference in the representation of known silence before model encoding. It supports a controlled frontend diagnostic correction. It does not establish that this floor is the cause of false captions or that correcting it qualifies the evaluator.
findings.fix: Preserve the original runtime and every existing artifact. If pursuing a diagnostic runtime variant, change only the validated Whisper floor to 1e-10 in a fresh copy. Require zero maximum reference error across 384000 silence values and the unchanged tone-buffer SHA256 68d1b7348e7134d252c6cb3329b4c1f85fd9fe6e6476c9a1aa54d51fc8ae1fa5. Read the independently verified numeric targets with: python3 -m json.tool /workspace/scratch/0b7ad82bafe7/audio-evaluator-diagnostic-refuter-01.json. Do not rerun the old artifact-writing scripts over prior evidence. These feature targets are not caption success gates.
findings.hypothesis: Confirmed feature mechanism: the actual qwen2.5o audio metadata remaps to QWEN2A and selects Whisper; that preprocessor inherits mel_floor=5.960464477539063e-08 without override. All returned frames enter the FFT clamp, then log10 and (x+4)/4. A one-assignment diagnostic variant removes the observed silence feature difference. The cause of the false silence caption remains UNPROVEN. The claim that this floor causes the known tone-sequence ordering error is REFUTED for these inputs: both feature buffers are byte-identical.

findings.materiality: Major as a diagnostic conformance gap affecting every returned value on the exact silence control; no audio-quality score or production severity is inferred.
findings.classification: Observed in the pinned upstream runtime source. No prior upstream revision was compared, so introduction date, deliberate intent and regression classification are not established.

refutations.claim: The observed zero input may contain real sine waves or be the wrong archived WAV.
refutations.evidence: Independent wave reader finds 64000/64000 zero samples in the same SHA256 f751fd7094be088dc785125e4a1a0222a17c2bd20469aa31728ca5e515ed5809. All 20 calibration archive members match originals and parent hash records. Completed silence caption still reports two sine-wave events.

refutations.claim: The higher floor is not reached because Qwen selects another preprocessor or the worker fills zero frames with its separate 1e-10 tail.
refutations.evidence: Fresh GGUF metadata read gives qwen2.5o and 128 mel bins. clip.cpp remaps audio to QWEN2A; mtmd.cpp selects Whisper. The zero input produces 544400 padded samples, 3401 full frames, FFT-loop bound 3403 before clamping to out.n_len; all returned 3000 frames use the FFT clamp. The literal 1e-10 tail is not reached for any returned frame.

refutations.claim: The one-floor harness changes more than the claimed calculation or disagrees with the retained raw output.
refutations.evidence: Independent text checks confirm the original calculation is the exact source prefix except its include, header types match, and deleting the single variant assignment gives the entire original harness byte-for-byte. Four fresh preprocessing-only executions reproduce all retained output buffers. The metadata context shim supplies 128/16k/400/160 and performs no neural inference.

refutations.claim: The two floors account for the incorrect tone chronology.
refutations.evidence: Both original and one-floor tone buffers have SHA256 68d1b7348e7134d252c6cb3329b4c1f85fd9fe6e6476c9a1aa54d51fc8ae1fa5, zero changed values. The global dynamic log10 floor -7.1044884 is higher than the original absolute log10 floor -7.2247199 and dominates both variants. The reference difference is at most 1.9669533e-5 in 3/384000 bins; this does not prove downstream encoding or masking correctness.

refutations.claim: The verified floor difference proves the source of the false silence caption, or proves that the variant repairs it.
refutations.evidence: No full runtime variant or new caption was executed. The feature mismatch and its isolated removal are proven; caption causality is not. A deliberate or compensated variant has no supporting evidence here, but this review does not establish upstream intent or an exact checkpoint processor contract beyond the pinned model-family reference.

refutations.claim: Missing --jinja or failure to attach --audio is an evidenced explanation or repair.
refutations.evidence: The exact arg.cpp maps --audio to params.image and reads -f into params.prompt. CLI single-turn code prepends the media marker, loads the WAV, formats text, interleaves media and checks marker counts. The actual selected mtmd path adds audio_bos/eos, and both completed logs show media encoding. No rendered multimodal prompt/tensor dump was archived, so this is not a complete prompt-parity proof.

refutations.claim: The initial backend error or current bare --version failure explains the later captions.
refutations.evidence: Initial calibration exited 1 with an empty stdout and no backend; both subsequent controls exited 0 and completed media encoding. Parent records scoped runtime cwd and confirms LD_LIBRARY_PATH. The full original launcher/environment is missing, which limits exact reproduction; it does not turn completed captions into load failures.

refutations.claim: These controls establish reliable evaluation of product sound or stereo position.
refutations.evidence: The known controls expose false captions and do not demonstrate listening-quality competence. mtmd-helper.cpp requests ma_format_f32 with channels=1, so independent stereo channels are not retained. This route cannot substantiate stereo channel localization. Sound criteria remain unchanged.

requested_draft_changes.change: Replace the implication that a correction is mandatory with the narrower conclusion that the measured mismatch supports a controlled diagnostic correction. The exact stack already failed both original controls, independently of whether this floor explains them.
Do not recommend rerunning audio-evaluator-diagnostic-preprocess.py over existing artifacts. Use fresh variant paths and retain every attempt; read the retained numeric results for current proof.

Keep the explicit distinction between isolated source execution, original shared-library runtime, pinned Transformers model-family reference, and unproven caption repair. No need to delete the narrow finding.

accepted_controls.archive_identity: Independently rechecked all 20 calibration archive members and archive hash. Parent full model and released runtime hash audit was read and accepted, not redundantly recomputed.
accepted_controls.known_sequence: Original mono 16k PCM16 data and zero/on-off windows independently checked; parent frequency-fit evidence read for 440Hz then intermittent 1kHz. These measures identify synthetic input bytes, not sound quality.

limitations: Existing isolated source executables were rerun after verifying their generated sources and recording binary hashes; the released libmtmd frontend, projector and neural model were not invoked.

The HF v4.52.3 reference functions and chosen no-dither/128-mel settings establish this numerical comparison. No claim is made that Transformers ran in the archived GGUF inference, or that the exact checkpoint processor configuration was archived.
Whole-frontend frame masking, downstream model math, launch environment and caption causality remain outside this source-only check.
No actual sound-quality, stereo-localization, reference comparison, element or product pass follows from the numerical agreement.
The finding is not classified as introduced by the game changes or as a specific upstream regression.
